key_terms.أبو ضريس: Abu Daris, the kunyah (nickname) of Abdul Malik
key_terms.الصادق: Al-Sadiq, referring to Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad
key_terms.المدينة: Medina, the city where the grave is located
key_terms.عبد الملك بن أعين: Abdul Malik bin A'yan, a narrator

ai.seo_question: Who is the narrator Abdul Malik bin A'yan and what is his connection to Imam Al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq clarifies the isnad for narrations from Abdul Malik bin A'yan, distinguishing between those he personally transmitted from Muhammad ibn Ali Majilawayh and those derived from the broader chain through Yunes ibn Abd al-Rahman. This verification underscores the reliability of the Majilawayh lineage in Shia scholarship, while the mention of Imam al-Sadiq visiting his grave highlights the spiritual status and intercessory potential of this companion within the tradition.
